Thanks again for the time today, Maya — good call. Quick recap and asks so we can keep the procurement path moving: 

Recap (from our side)
- Pilot scope: Redwood-managed inference for HearthTech analytics (ingest + 10k tokens/month, 30k embedding units), 30-day pilot.
- SLO expectations: p95 latency target ~150ms, retry/fallback to smaller model if capacity constrained.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: per-unit cost, security attestations (SOC2), data residency, and integration effort.

Asks / next logistic items
1) Please confirm the economic buyer / approver for this purchase (name + email).
2) Who owns vendor onboarding and vendor-record creation at HearthTech? (procurement contact + billing contact).
3) Any required vendor paperwork (W9, vendor form) we should complete now — I attached our draft SOW and our standard W9 for speed.
4) Target timeline: can you confirm when procurement typically issues a PO after receiving the vendor packet?

Attachments: SOW_Redwood-v1.docx (draft), Redwood_W9.pdf (stub)

If you prefer, we can send a condensed vendor packet that your team can drop into your intake system.

Next step: Maya — if you can reply with procurement contact and expected PO timing, I’ll loop in Sales Ops (Laura) to get our finance vendor setup started.

Thanks,
Ben

Hi Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement/legal side below.

Procurement owner: Sanjay Mehta (Procurement Manager) — sanjay.mehta@hearthtech.com (please copy procurement@hearthtech.com for formal intake).
Legal review: Alexei Petrov (in-house counsel) — looping him for any standard addenda; typical turnaround is 3–5 business days for standard SOWs.
Vendor onboarding steps (what we need from vendor)
- Completed vendor packet (see attached vendor_packet_checklist.pdf)
- W9 / Tax form (if US entity)
- Banking details for EFT set up (we accept vendor portal or emailed secure link)

PO timing (typical)
- If we receive a completed packet + W9: vendor intake ~3–5 business days.
- PO issuance: typically 7–10 business days after intake, depending on budget owner availability.

Compliance ask: we will need a current SOC 2 Type II report and a basic subprocessor list. If you can provide those as part of the packet that will speed things.

Attaching: HearthTech_vendor_packet.pdf (form + checklist), vendor_packet_checklist.pdf

Happy to do a short follow-up with Sanjay if helpful.

Best,
Maya Santos
